title: digislicer
author: irpina
description: A slice editor for the SLICE machine: hold YES on a SLICE track's SRC page to edit a sample's slice points (split, delete, move, auto-slice on transients, equal grids) and play them from the trig keys. A sample's own slices play on every SLICE track, whatever GRID says, and are kept per sample on the +Drive (/cfw/slices.a, .b). GRID also gets AUTO: slices on the sample's transients.
